news.title: What Happened to Alice Huang, the Woman at the Center of Nvidia’s Scandal?
news.summary: U.S. intelligence found no evidence that Beijing directed Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia’s CEO, but the former Megaspeed executive still faces entry bans and scrutiny of business ties.

news.title: The 1Password Breach Didn’t Touch Your Vault. The Phishing Emails Might
news.summary: An attacker compromised an employee’s GitHub account to reach 1Password’s backend and copy customer names and emails, but the company says vault contents, encryption keys and your Secret Key were never exposed.

news.title: Another Bitcoin Mining Firm Flags 'Hashrate Hijacking' Attacks That Reroute Rewards
news.summary: Braiins says an attacker exploited the unencrypted Stratum V1 protocol and internet route hijacking to impersonate mining pools, striking over 1,000 sites in a single second.

news.title: What Is Artex? The AI Hacking Tool Linked to the US Spy Agency Breach
news.summary: Microsoft says state-backed hackers and cybercriminals are using Artex to automate attacks with AI agents, exploiting familiar security flaws at speeds that leave defenders little time to respond or recover.

news.title: Switzerland clears 57 jurisdictions for crypto tax data sharing
news.summary: The move paves the way for Switzerland to exchange crypto tax data with foreign authorities starting in 2028 as part of a global effort to combat tax evasion.

news.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
news.summary: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.

news.title: Why ECB collateral eligibility could boost demand for tokenized bonds
news.summary: Past ECB decisions offer clues to the value of using bonds as collateral, while US derivatives exchanges face a different calculation over their Bitcoin holdings.

news.title: 摩根大通：AI资本支出明年逼近1.4万亿美元 2028年或迎增长拐点
news.summary:
【摩根大通：AI资本支出明年逼近1.4万亿美元 2028年或迎增长拐点】金色财经报道，11月26日，摩根大通分析师表示，尽管蓬勃发展的人工智能行业未来可能面临增长见顶的局面，但企业明年仍将通过公开市场发行4500亿美元投资级债券，为人工智能相关资本支出提供资金。据该行估算，今年专注于人工智能业务的企业全球投资级债券发行规模为3680亿美元。小摩策略师在报告中写道，2027年人工智能相关资本支出将接近翻倍，达到1.4万亿美元，随后一年趋于稳定。策略师预计，随着行业逐渐进入稳定发展阶段，2028年资本支出增速将大幅放缓。策略师写道：“由于整个行业的增长速度放缓，2027年末或2028年初的某个季度，市场对下一季度资本支出的预期可能基本持平。市场对此会作出积极还是消极的反应，目前还很难判断。”

原文链接: https://flash.jin10.com/detail/20261126052922582800

news.title: 美三大股指低开后震荡回升，盘中持续修复
news.summary: 【美三大股指低开后震荡回升，盘中持续修复】金色财经报道，11月26日，美三大股指低开后震荡回升，盘中持续修复。道琼斯指数翻红收涨0.33%，标普500指数小幅收跌0.25%，纳斯达克综合指数跌0.62%。芯片股继续调整，抛压有所消化，费城半导体指数收跌0.65%，其中英伟达跌近4%，盘中一度跌近9%。AMD跌近2%，美光科技跌4.5%。大型科技股表现分化，Anthropic低开高走，涨超1%，盘中一度跌超9%。Meta涨超3%，SpaceX涨超1%；亚马逊跌约3%，谷歌跌2%。
